Reopening condition: a condition-specific pathway with its own published evidence base distinct from the atopic-dermatitis literature (for example, an eczema-specific cohort outcome not explained by the AD evidence) would justify re-screening this identity.

SCOPE SPLIT DECISION 2026-09-28 - NOT CONSOLIDATED, and the identity-duplication finding is RETRACTED as erroneous at the evidence level. Batches 80 and 82 recorded eczema and atopic-dermatitis-eczema as IDENTITY-DUPLICATION, 'open identities for the same disease', and this file's own note called the identity 'a common clinical synonym for atopic dermatitis rather than a distinct disease process'. The registered evidence contradicts that reading. The repo's own qualified-human-VERIFIED route into this identity is psoriasis -> eczema at POST_SURGICAL_OR_TREATMENT, whose source is the prospective biologic-registry study 'Risk of Paradoxical Eczema in Patients Receiving Biologics for Psoriasis' (JAMA Dermatol. 2024;160(1):71-79, PMID 38055239, verified 2026-08-19) and whose guard states that eczema must NOT be inferred from psoriasis itself and that exposure to the implicated biologic is required. PARADOXICAL ECZEMA IS A DRUG-INDUCED ECZEMATOUS ERUPTION AND IS NOT ATOPIC DERMATITIS. The two identities therefore hold two different disease routes - this identity the iatrogenic eczematous eruption, atopic-dermatitis-eczema the atopic march to asthma - and no single merged identity can preserve both qualified-human-verified mappings. Consolidating into atopic-dermatitis-eczema would assert that biologic therapy causes ATOPIC DERMATITIS, a category error on a human-approved mapping; consolidating in the other direction would assert that eczema in general causes asthma, a widening beyond the atopic-dermatitis-phenotype evidence. SCOPE BOUNDARY RECORDED: this identity owns the generic and iatrogenic eczematous eruptions including paradoxical eczema; atopic-dermatitis-eczema owns the atopic-disease route. No claim routed here may be extended to atopic dermatitis, and no claim there may be widened to generic eczema. The catalog aliases were tightened accordingly: this identity now carries 'paradoxical eczema' and 'drug-induced eczema', and the sibling now carries 'atopic dermatitis'. REOPENING CONDITION MET AND THIS NOTE IS ITS RECORD: this file's earlier note set a reopening condition of 'a condition-specific pathway with its own published evidence base distinct from the atopic-dermatitis literature (for example, an eczema-specific cohort outcome not explained by the AD evidence)', and the verified paradoxical-eczema biologic-registry route is exactly such a pathway, so the duplicate-scope deferral is closed rather than left pending.

The negative screen of 2026-09-23 is unchanged and still stands: no outgoing eczema edge was authored, the insomnia direction located was insomnia-to-AD and therefore incompatible with an outgoing eczema-to-insomnia edge and blocked by the parallel-pathway ban, and the pediatric multi-inflammatory-skin-disease record was psoriasis-anchored and supplies no condition-specific outgoing anchor. The scope split does not revive any of those routes.

ROUTE RE-SCREEN 2026-09-28 (1 of 2) - ptsd -> eczema RE-SCREENED ON ITS OWN EVIDENCE after the identity-duplication premise of batch 80 was retracted, and the route REMAINS WITHHELD, now on evidence grounds alone: the identity-duplication ground is REMOVED from the rationale. The only located positive in generic-eczema scope is the 2008 Australian Vietnam veterans epidemiological study (PMID 18157997), which reports PTSD associated with ICD-9-coded eczema before and after confounder control but with NO LOCATED MAGNITUDE and with self-reported, phenotype-unspecified eczema. Against it, the newer diagnosis-based case-control comparison of 220 CAPS-5-diagnosed PTSD patients and 196 trauma-exposed controls reports CURRENT ECZEMA NOT ASSOCIATED with PTSD (p = 0.24) while atopy and allergic rhinitis were (PMID 35580455); the 2,973-participant SHIP TREND-0 population study reports childhood maltreatment NOT a risk factor for dermatologist-diagnosed atopic dermatitis in adults (PMID 35920760); the 122-patient severe occupational hand eczema study reports symptoms NOT more severe among patients with greater stress and burnout, with chronic stress predicting only cumulative sickness absence (PMID 24994848); and the systematic review of 30 Mendelian-randomization studies in atopic dermatitis lists NO psychiatric causal factor among the causes of AD (PMID 37977498). The located positive adversity signals are SCOPE-MISMATCHED and are NOT registered here: the ACEs dose-response with childhood atopic dermatitis (aOR 2.10 at three or more ACEs at age 5, attenuating to NULL by age 15, PMID 32168146) is atopic-scoped and exposure-mismatched, and the PTSD dermatology review's flare claims name psoriasis, chronic urticaria and ATOPIC DERMATITIS specifically (PMID 28511822), a window already held at the sibling atopic-dermatitis-eczema identity in the batch-89 held artifact; per the 2026-09-28 scope split no claim routed to one identity may be extended to the other's scope, and per ME-29 held evidence is not recycled here. REOPENING CONDITION: a phenotype-documented generic-eczema cohort reporting a PTSD exposure with a stated magnitude, or a design reconciling the 2008 veterans association with the 2022 diagnosis-based null. PMID 18157997 is preserved as reserved literature for that reopening.

ROUTE RE-SCREEN 2026-09-28 (2 of 2) - anxiety-disorder -> eczema RE-SCREENED ON ITS OWN EVIDENCE under the same retraction and REMAINS WITHHELD as COMORBIDITY-WITHOUT-DIRECTION and DIRECTION REVERSAL. The only population anchor located is the Northern Finland Birth Cohort 1966 study (853 hand eczema among 6,695 respondents), which reports anxiety symptoms enriched among hand-eczema subjects (crude OR 1.40, adjusted OR 1.34) at a single cross-sectional assessment and can support NEITHER arrow, least of all anxiety preceding eczema; the sibling dermatitis identity (Dermatitis (Atopic / Contact)) already owns the correctly-directed psychiatric-morbidity window (dermatitis -> anxiety-disorder rank 5, -> depressive-disorder rank 4, -> insomnia rank 1), so an anxiety -> eczema edge would register the REVERSE of a registered route across a sibling identity on non-directional evidence; the salivary-cortisol and perceived-stress record in chronic contact hand dermatitis (PMID 37579769) carries NO ABSTRACT and cannot anchor a claim; and the stress/severity, maltreatment and Mendelian-randomization nulls recorded in the preceding note apply equally here (PMIDs 24994848, 35920760, 37977498). Hand eczema is moreover the contact/irritant scope the dermatitis identity owns. REOPENING CONDITION: a prospective design locating anxiety or a documented anxiety disorder BEFORE incident, phenotype-documented eczema with a stated magnitude. NEITHER PMID IS REGISTERED: this re-screen created no source entity, no reference use and no relationship, and no pin moved.
